item.summary: fix(plugins): adopt root context engines on caller-owned handles (#122457) Keep caller-owned agent runtime registries in discovery mode so full-only plugins cannot replace process-global sandbox backends. Copy runtime context-engine factories from the composition-root registry instead. Co-authored-by: Josh Lehman <550978+jalehman@users.noreply.github.com>
